note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-5 English Wikipedia article on the Honda CB750 and CR750. Every value is grade claimed and the registry marks primary_held false. The article is a secondary compilation and is not a primary source.

curb_weight_kg.state: wet weight published as 513 lb; pounds converted to kilograms, 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg; the infobox also publishes a 218 kg dry weight and the wet weight is recorded as the curb basis

length_mm.state: length published as 85 in; inches converted to millimetres

width_mm.state: width published as 35 in; inches converted to millimetres

height_mm.state: height published as 44 in; inches converted to millimetres

wheelbase_mm.state: wheelbase published as 57.3 in; inches converted to millimetres

engine_displacement_l.state: engine displacement published as 736 cc (1969 to 1978)

published_power_hp.state: power published as 68 hp at 8,500 rpm (1969); maximum rating, no net basis

transmission_type.state: transmission published as a 5-speed manual with a chain final drive

drivetrain.state: final drive published as a roller chain to the rear wheel
